column1: # Format: reading\tsurface\tpos (exactly 3 columns; a cost column is an error)
#   - pos: a full 7-field id.def POS tag, one of ALLOWED_POS_TAGS in
#     symbols.rs (記号,一般 / 記号,アルファベット). compile resolves the tag
#     to its numeric id from the pinned id.def; an unknown tag, a tag missing
#     from id.def, or a missing id.def fails the build.
# POS follows Mozc's own symbol dictionary (src/data/symbol/symbol.tsv):
# Greek letters are 記号,アルファベット, every other row is 記号,一般. The six
# characters that file does not have (ℙ ∏ ≈ ≤ ≥ ♩) are not Greek and are
# 記号,一般 by the same split.
# Symbols live outside the lattice: compile flags every row as a symbol entry,
# lattice construction builds no nodes from them, and a row whose
# (reading, surface) is also in mozc or extras fails the build (remove the row);
# a duplicate inside symbols is a build error too.
# A symbol's cost is its row index among the rows with the same reading
# (0, 1, 2, … in file order), so the row order is the candidate order.
# --- Greek letters (uppercase; visually distinct from Latin only) ---
